jobs.title: Lecturer/Senior Lecturer in Data Systems and Engineering
jobs.fitReason: Strong AI, multimodal-data and teaching overlap, but the role is fundamentally database/data-systems focused and favours a systems publication record.

jobs.title: Lecturer in Artificial Intelligence
jobs.fitReason: Excellent match to AI, ML, neural networks, generative AI/LLMs plus substantial university teaching and an emerging research publication profile.

jobs.title: Lecturer/Senior Lecturer in Robotics and Mechatronic Engineering
jobs.fitReason: AI/computer-vision and teaching skills transfer, but the position specifically expects a robotics/mechatronics PhD and research record in that field.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Associate - Wireless Communication
jobs.fitReason: Good ML/AIoT, research-code and deep-learning transferability, but the core research is wireless communications, RFID and backscatter systems rather than multimodal AI.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow - Usable Privacy and Privacy-Preserving Learning
jobs.fitReason: Strong trustworthy/responsible AI, privacy, provenance, software research and cybersecurity overlap; weaker only on the HCI/XR-specific component.

jobs.title: Senior Lecturer/Lecturer, Business Technology and Analytics
jobs.fitReason: AI, analytics and digital-technology themes fit, with useful teaching experience, but the role is Level C/business-school oriented and expects a more established academic leadership profile.

jobs.title: Lecturer / Senior Lecturer - Machine Learning
jobs.fitReason: Very strong ML, deep learning, computer vision, applied AI and teaching alignment; the main gaps are completed-PhD timing and stronger grant/HDR-supervision expectations.

jobs.title: Research Fellow, Computational Systems Modelling for Road Safety
jobs.fitReason: Solid computational modelling, data analysis and research-method transferability, but human factors, systems thinking and road-safety modelling are outside the core research profile.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellow – Machine Learning Engineering
jobs.fitReason: Excellent ML/deep-learning engineering, reproducible-code and research fit; the health-neuroinformatics domain is new but highly transferable and the 2027 start suits near-completion timing.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Computer Science
jobs.fitReason: Exceptional match: multimodal AI, digital media forensics, media manipulation, cyber-enabled trust, explainability and near-completion PhD eligibility align directly with the research profile.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Power System Stability
jobs.fitReason: Some data-driven modelling overlap, but the essential expertise is electrical engineering, power electronics, power-system stability and hardware/HIL validation.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellow
jobs.fitReason: Computer science and machine-learning applications are allowed, but the project specifically requires research experience in category theory, which is not a core strength in the current profile.
